title: 2 Kings, 1 Queen | Garage | Front Yard | W&D
description:
🏡Welcome to Your Nashville Getaway!

Looking for a relaxing escape outside the city buzz? You’ve found it. Our brand-new brick townhome offers the perfect mix of peaceful retreat and prime location—just minutes from Old Hickory Lake and a short drive into the heart of Nashville.

Whether you're here for a lakeside adventure, a family trip, or a weekend of music and fun, we’ve got you covered. Flexible dates or a bigger group? Ask us about our nearby homes!

DISCOUNTS FOR 30/60-DAY PLUS STAY!

The space
✨ What Makes This Space Special

🌊 Close to the Lake
Only 3 minutes by car (or 15-minute walk) to Old Hickory Lake. Boat rentals, water sports, and peaceful views await!

🛏 Dreamy Sleep
Guests love our hotel-quality mattresses. Whether you're resting after a concert or lake day, you’ll sleep well here.

🍳 Fully Stocked Kitchen
Cook a full meal or a quick bite—our kitchen has everything you need.

🍽 Cozy Dining Area
Gather with friends or family for meals and conversation in a warm, welcoming space.

📺 Spacious Living Room
Kick back with a comfy sectional and 50” Smart TV—perfect for a night in.

🚿 2.5 Bathrooms
Plenty of space for everyone to freshen up—includes a tub and walk-in shower.

🚗 Easy Parking
Attached garage + two driveway spots. No street parking stress!

📍 Location Highlights
12 minutes from Nashville International Airport

Quick drive to Downtown, Broadway, Opry, and Opry Mills

Quiet area—perfect for relaxing after exploring

Guest access
🛎 Full Guest Access
You’ll have the entire home, including:

Private garage

Two additional parking spots

Full access to all rooms and amenities

We can’t wait to host you. Questions or need local tips? Just let us know!
